properties.name: Soldiers' & Sailors' Monument
properties.note: Free inside. The tunnel labyrinth underneath opens one day a year — ask at the desk.

properties.name: Chess Collection, Cleveland Public Library
properties.note: World's largest chess collection. Photo ID; one item at a time. Closed Sunday.

properties.name: The Arcade
properties.note: 1890 glass-roofed arcade modelled on Milan's Galleria. Lunch inside.

properties.name: Terminal Tower Observation Deck
properties.note: Weekends only, ~$5–6, tickets online in advance. No walk-ups.

properties.name: Free Stamp
properties.note: Oldenburg & van Bruggen's giant rubber stamp. Two minutes, always open.

properties.name: USS Cod Submarine Memorial
properties.note: Last intact WWII fleet sub. Entry down a vertical ladder — not accessible.

properties.name: Percy Skuy Collection, Dittrick Medical History Center
properties.note: Fri 10:30–4 and Sat 12–4 ONLY. Free. 1,000+ contraceptive artifacts.

properties.name: Cleveland Museum of Art
properties.note: Free. Enter from Wade Park for the view across the lagoon. Closed Monday.

properties.name: Cleveland Museum of Natural History
properties.note: Lucy, Balto, and an Apollo 12 moon rock. Closed Monday.

properties.name: Haserot Angel, Lake View Cemetery
properties.note: Grab a map at the gate. Nearest landmark is the Hanna Mausoleum.

properties.name: Rockefeller Park Greenhouse
properties.note: Closes at 4pm — swap earlier in the day. Free.

properties.name: Quintana's Speakeasy
properties.note: Back door of the barbershop, buzzer, 'a man about a horse', then pull the right book.

properties.name: West Side Market
properties.note: Bring cash. Closed Tuesday and Thursday. First hour parking free.

properties.name: Buckland Museum of Witchcraft & Magick
properties.note: Gardner's artifacts, Sybil Leek's crystal ball, a demon in a box. Allow an hour.

properties.name: A Christmas Story House
properties.note: Tours every 30 min from 10:15. Budget two hours.

properties.name: b.a. Sweetie Candy Company
properties.note: A warehouse of candy, plus a soda fountain.

properties.name: Superelectric Pinball Parlor
properties.note: Flat fee, unlimited play. Closed Tuesday.

properties.name: The Sanctuary Museum
properties.note: Wed mornings and Sat afternoons ONLY. Rescued church statuary.

properties.name: Solstice Steps, Lakewood Park
properties.note: Best sunset in the region. Arrive 30 min early for a lower terrace.
